tasks.title: Tasks

hint.wires: Drag the left terminal to the matching colour on the right.
hint.levers: Flip every switch up. All lamps must light.
hint.valve: Hold the wheel to raise pressure. Keep the needle in the green.
hint.geiger: Use the slider to bring the needle to the green zone and hold it.
hint.filter: Tap every dust spot on the filter to clean it.
hint.keypad: Type the 5-digit code on the note and press ✔.
hint.simon: Watch the lit squares and repeat the order. 3 rounds.
hint.swipe: Swipe the card left to right, not too fast, not too slow.
hint.align: Tap each dial to rotate it. All must point up.
hint.download: Press DOWNLOAD and wait until full.
hint.upload: Press UPLOAD and wait until full.
hint.fuel: The level rises and falls. Press LOCK while it is in the green band. 3 times.
hint.order: Press 1 to 9 in order. A mistake resets you.
hint.pipes: Tap tiles to rotate them. Build an unbroken pipe from the blue inlet to the right edge.
hint.waste: Hazardous items go to the yellow-black bin, the rest to the blue one. Mistakes cost 2 points.
hint.freq: Use both sliders to match the green wave to the dashed yellow one and hold it.
hint.scan: Press your hand on the scanner and keep holding until it finishes.

menu.serverHint: Leave empty if you opened the game from the server. If you opened the file, enter the server address (e.g. mygame.onrender.com).
menu.howtoText:
Everyone secretly gets a role.
• CREWMATE: Do tasks, stay alive. REPORT bodies.
• SHERIFF: Find and shoot the Impostor. Shoot an innocent and you die.
• IMPOSTOR: Kill unseen, use tunnels, SABOTAGE.
Talk in meetings and vote out the suspect. Crew wins if all tasks are done or the Impostor is ejected.
